subject.title: Feature: add gateway.controlUi.timezone for Control UI timestamp rendering

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `gateway.controlUi.timezone` setting for Control UI timestamp rendering, and which value contract should it support?
rationale: The request is a plausible web-frontend ergonomics improvement, but it adds a public Gateway Control UI config/bootstrap surface where repository policy requires maintainer acceptance of the product contract and compatibility behavior.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Additive Config
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR direction after it preserves current `timeFormat`, documents the key, proves browser rendering, and keeps omitted config as current browser-local behavior.

options.title: Revise The Value Model
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a different contract, such as adding `browser`/`user` modes or reusing existing timezone concepts before implementation lands.

options.title: Decline Core Config
options.body: Reject a new core setting and keep Control UI timestamp timezone tied to browser behavior unless a broader settings design is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept A Narrow Additive Config
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR direction after it preserves current `timeFormat`, documents the key, proves browser rendering, and keeps omitted config as current browser-local behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and earlier history both tie Peter to the Control UI bootstrap/config path that would carry this public setting.
